decisions.reason: The accepted series-resistor placement changes I2C signal conditioning topology, not the assigned ESP32-S3 GPIOs or GPIO compatibility policy.
The source concerns placement of I2C series resistors in the signal path and does not affect the battery connector's physical placement or accessibility.
The I2C series-resistor topology does not change the standalone 3.3V regulator, source selection, activation condition, or powered load.
The source does not alter the interboard connector types, pin counts, pinouts, or matching pin-order rule; it only locates optional resistors on the I2C signal path.
The accepted resistor placement is unrelated to the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, and 3.3V power-path requirements.
The source changes neither the 5V rail's enable GPIO nor its converter, loads, pull-down, or shutdown behavior.
The source establishes electrical placement for already optional 22-ohm resistors and makes no component availability, sourcing, or cost decision.
The I2C resistor placement does not affect the separate eight-LED board, its LED count, or its SK6812 device family.
Although the sensor modules use I2C, the source does not change which modules are connected, their supply, or the sensor board's interface role.
The source concerns I2C series resistors and does not resolve or alter the battery connector's series, mounting type, or pinout.
The accepted electrical placement does not explicitly change BOM documentation requirements or any currently tracked BOM entry.
The source does not affect KiCad project portability, library resolution, or the previously addressed footprint warning.
